title: FlowOrchestrationStageInstance - Data API
description: Represents a run-time instance of a stage in a run-time instance of an orchestration. This read-only object is available in API version 53.0 and later.

Label.description: The label for the flow orchestration stage instance. This label helps users and administrators differentiate between step instances from the same orchestration.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The API name for the flow orchestration stage instance.

OrchestrationInstanceId.description: The ID of the FlowOrchestrationInstance associated with the orchestration stage instance. This field is a relationship field.

OrchestrationName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
OrchestrationName.description: The API name of flow orchestration stage instance. This field is available in API version 66.0 and later.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the automated process user. This field is available in API version 56.0 and later.

Status.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The run status of the orchestration stage instance. Valid values are: Completed—The stage instance completed. Discontinued—The stage was in progress or completed when the orchestration instance encountered an error. Error—The stage instance encountered an error, an instance of a background step within the stage encountered and error, or an autolaunched flow called by a background step within the stage encountered an error. InProgress—The stage instance is in progress. Suspended—The stage was in progress when the orchestration instance was manually suspended.

special_access_rules: If sharing rules are defined for FlowOrchestrationStageInstance, they determine access to specific orchestration stage run records. Or the user must have the View All Data permission.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. If the API version isn’t specified, they’re available in the same API versions as this object. Otherwise, they’re available in the specified API version and later.

- **FlowOrchestrationStageInstanceFeed**: Feed tracking is available for the object.
- **FlowOrchestrationStageInstanceHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **FlowOrchestrationStageInstanceOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **FlowOrchestrationStageInstanceShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
